notes.title: New Boss, New Enemies, Sound Rework, and MORE! - Post-Release Update #4
notes.notes:
Hello Wardens!

Some new robots are frustrated for not having a valentine and want to lash out at you! 

Here's what we have for this update:

New Content

- New boss, Dragonfly
- New regular enemies, Healer and Biter
- Added new foliage to enhance environmental visibility

Changes and Improvements

- Weapon sound rework
- Abilities sound rework
- Chests variety (Yellow gives gold while blue gives meta currency)
- Greatly improved build stability for multiplayer
- The Tether enemy no longer cancels your movement; instead, it gradually drains it
- General bug fixes

Thank you for your support! We're not done, we'll keep expanding the world of Warden's Will!

notes.title: Introducing the Warden’s Will Roadmap - Post-Release Update #3
notes.notes:
Hello Wardens! 
We have been hard at work addressing your feedback and continuing to improve Warden’s Will. Today, we are excited to share a massive update, including recent changes and the unveiling of our Roadmap, which provides a glimpse into the future of the game. 

Recent Updates 
Here is what is new and improved in this patch: 

- Levels now unlock upon entry, allowing you to play them in any order during future runs
- Deactivate level hazards by shooting at them
- Augments UI has changed from icons to text for improved clarity
- Crystal buffs are now displayed on the HUD
- D4_Sher is immune to damage during 'Explosive Trailstring (E)' ability
- Bits are now kept after reviving
- Byte Chests are now free and greater in number
- Damage numbers have been scaled to properly display damage buffs
- Damage numbers visuals have been improved
- Sound compression has been enhanced for improved audio quality
- Transmitters now require less data and load faster
- Electrilance continuous heat reduction bug has been fixed
- Overheat Augments have been removed until reworked for a better alternative
- Balancing updates
- Art and shader improvements
- Settings screen fixes

THE ROADMAP
We are excited to reveal our future plans, which are divided into three key steps:

Step One
Fixing reported bugs and addressing major pain points raised by the community

Step Two
Introducing highly requested features, including looping runs, new enemies, augment improvements, difficulty settings, and various gameplay improvements

Step Three
Expanding replayability with new game modes, bosses, enemies, improvements to the augment system, and some other crazy ideas that we will test with our testers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/06bdfbc5336c008c31ebc2ed02ef87e5caf6d7a1.jpg

The outlined steps are provisional and may be modified based on various factors, including community feedback.

“Warden Protocol Community Program” - Join the Playtests

We are also excited to announce our new community program “Warden Protocol” 

This initiative is our way of recognizing and appreciating our amazing community members who actively contribute. By joining, you’ll get an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at our development process. Best of all, it’s completely free! All you need to do is join our Discord, participate in playtests, and share your feedback
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/fcce6277a41b67770caec3f1da1416259615882d.jpg
Everyone can join the playtests. Here is how you can do it:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/d6be47ec4c09c62a0ca8ea620233007e99a101b3.gif

Name: beta-testing
Password: PshJ3ZB3EM0kD8UeW0grG

Thank you for your support and feedback. Together, we will make Warden’s Will better than ever. (edited)

notes.title: Abilities in Boss Fights and Faster Progress - Post-Release Update #1
notes.notes:
First, we want to thank each and every one of you for playing Warden’s Will and providing your feedback on launch day. Your enthusiasm and thoughts mean the world to us!

In response to your feedback, we worked tirelessly to address two key areas to enhance your experience, even just hours after release:

Abilities Enabled During Boss Fights
Movement and attack abilities are now fully enabled during boss fights! We understand that movement is a core element of Warden’s Will, and we want you to enjoy the fluidity of the gameplay rather than feel restricted. (We’ll keep fine-tuning and balancing to ensure the best experience!)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/4a8e7f38406e4f932d0f7db4fe90be9726c18ad2.gif

Faster Progress for Unlocking Wardens & Weapons
Many of you mentioned that the progression for unlocking Wardens and weapons felt a bit too slow. To address this, we reduced unlock costs and increased the rewarded currency. These changes will make it easier and faster for you to unlock and upgrade your favorite Wardens and weapons.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/687522bf12daf22bbbb1d86d0215fc7d1698ac52.jpg

[hr][/hr]

We’re working tirelessly to make Warden’s Will the best it can be. Stay tuned for more updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689640/Wardens_Will/

notes.title: Warden's Will - Upcoming Changes
notes.notes:
Hello Wardens! 

The full release of Warden’s Will is almost here, so we wanted to give you a small sneak peek of what’s going to be arriving on January 8th! The feedback you gave us during the playtests helped with this immensely, and we’re grateful for all your help. Warden’s Will wouldn’t be what it is today without your support! 

But enough talking, let’s get to the changes! Just don’t forget to wishlist the game! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689640/Wardens_Will/

New Features

 New Augments: We’ve added a lot of new augments to the game to enhance the build variety! Some of them include unique abilities and triggers, making the gameplay much more versatile when you find one.
 Level Expansions: We’ve fully updated levels 4 and 5 of the game with new looks, hazards, and environments. We can’t wait for you to see them in all their glory! 
 Dynamic Difficulty Scaling: We want this game to be fun and challenging no matter the number of players, so we’re introducing dynamic difficulty scaling in the full release, which will account for the number of players in the lobby! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/44ae05479c305818ad7c7ed67f84b314f28ceee9.gif

Enemy Behavior:

 We’ve improved the enemy AI, so outsmarting the toughest of them can be a bit tougher! We’ve also updated the enemy spawning system, so tougher enemies are more likely to spawn, the more time you spend on the level. Prepare for a challenge! 
 We’ve reworked some of the bosses based on your feedback. For example, we’ve toned down the health pools of the starting bosses to positively impact the early-game progression, and we’ve also updated the Final boss fight to exclude the invincibility windows it previously had, which were a point of frustration for some of our players during the playtests! 
 And, of course, there’s more flare - we’ve added cinematic intro sequences for all boss fights, and they’re EPIC.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/8a395ca611ff974ff916dbf02a3dcd7a3fbbaf9f.gif

Loot and Economy:

 We’ve rebalanced the overall economy and loot spawn logic since some of you noted that during the playtests it was sometimes preferable to stay on the first stage instead of progressing to the next levels. So now you can expect much better loot as you progress through the levels, and you won’t need to farm everything in one place! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/daa25c19d649137145eeec502967f969a1767bab.gif

[hr][/hr]

These are just some of the things that will be included in the full release of Warden’s Will but we wanted to highlight them to you, Wardens, so you know what to expect from the game and know that your feedback was heard and implemented! 

Only a day left until January 8, and we can’t wait for you to try the finished game! 

Don’t forget to wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689640/Wardens_Will/

And Join our Discord:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/b282e21382cdd97f196a9206858efca5c81e6432.png

notes.title: Warden's Will Demo Update #1 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Wardens!

We've just put out an update for the Warden's Will Demo for Next Fest! Here is a video below explaining what we have changed in short, or you can read the whole thing below. Go now and destroy some evil robots!

[previewyoutube=J46CsPgHn2M;full][/previewyoutube]

Heroes

General

 Faster ground movement
 Fixed consistency of reactors trails
 Added low health indicator
 Added visual effects to better represents effective bonuses and augments
 Changed Damage Taken SFX

Dasher

 Complete rework of the hero movement
 Faster and shorter dashes
 Dashes are now directional
 Energy regen is much faster
 Trailstring is faster and has 4 dashes
 Bladestorm can now be chained/re-triggered if not all 10 attacks are used

Hover

 Closer camera when hovering to emphasize shooting
 Lower energy consumption
 Ion Cannon damage is higher and duration is shorter
 Orbital Strike triggers faster
 Orbital Strike camera zooms out while targeting

Flyer

 Now gains speed going downwards while losing speed going upwards
 This results in longer range with proper use
 Faster energy regen
 Camera tweaks


Weapons

 New weapon : Cryoflare ! Is it cold ? Is it hot ? Who knows !
 Minor sound effect changes - Some are still placeholders

Enemies

General    

 Improved performances in some specific areas of the level 1
 Improved visual feedback whenever an enemy spawns
 Fixed attack animation of the Howitzer
 Added visual cues when a Driller attacks
 SFX improvements for attack telegraphs

Breaches

 Changed visuals of the enemy breaches

Level Changes


 Necrogod influence has spread following failed wardens attempt to save Sentient installation.
 Fixed multiple collision issues


Interactables


General

 Added white outline whenever player can use the interaction key with an interactable
 Collecting Bits and Data is now “a bit” easier
 Improved visibility of price display when approaching Augments dispensers

Transmitter

 Revamped all visuals
 When fully uploaded, a transmitter now hint locations leading toward other transmitters
 Exposed the list of transmitters to find under the objective tracker in the user interface

Crystals

 Added an effect to better represent the area of effect triggered upon crystal destruction
 Red crystal now grants a temporary damage boost


Accessibility


 Removed tutorial level section
 Fixed stutter and/or flickering that could appear when launching the game
 Added more contextual tutorial hints when playing
 Added hints during loading screens
 Better gamepad support overall
 You can now tweak 3 different and cumulative aim assist settings from Options menu
 Aim Assist can be set for mouse-keyboard and gamepad separately
 Graphic settings now fully works as intended - except Shading Quality that has no effect at the moment
 Audio settings now fully works as intended
 Added missing icons for mouse-keyboard in case of remapping
 Remapping a key when playing will now properly be updated on the user interface without requiring the game to be relaunched
